title: Three Generations by Fruit Tree with Toddler in Wagon, 1930s Snapshot Photo
description: A charming Depression-era outdoor snapshot capturing three generations of a family in a sunny yard or orchard. An elderly matriarch wearing spectacles and a traditional dark dress is seated on a wooden chair, while a young mother in a collared knit cardigan and midi skirt stands beside her before a dense, fruit-laden tree. At their feet, a barefoot toddler in a light sunsuit sits contently inside a small metal toy wagon. The reverse bears black mounting paper remnants and a stamped negative/print number '202'.
